How dumb do they think I am?
Huh? A check?

Mr. Simpson, I can assure you,
this check of yours is nonnegotiable.

Oh, yeah?
Well, what makes you so damn sure?

and "This is not a check"?

- " Mr. Banker, do not honor."

I had a feeling it was
too good to be true.

Every time you get a million dollars,
something queers the deal.

I don't think real checks

Well, at least we got
a free sample of Reading Digest.

Marge, I never read
a magazine in my life,
and I'm not gonna start now.
No, it's not the truth, Homer.

It's well-documented that women
are safer drivers than men.

don't have any deep meaning.

They're just stupid drawings
that give you a cheap laugh.

Hey, Einstein,
put down your reading.

Hey, you don't wanna eat?
What you do, get one of them
stomach staples?

As Tolstoy said
in Quotable Notables...

"Give me learning, sir,
and you may keep your black bread."

- Who is that bookworm, Smithers?
- Homer Simpson, sir.

His job description
clearly specifies an illiterate.

We now return to Troy McClure
and Delores Montenegro
in Preacher With a Shovel.

But Irrigation can save
your people, Chief Smiling Bear.

Marge, look at them
staring at that idiot box.

God forbid they would
ever read something
and improve their minds.

You've certainly taken
a shine to that magazine.

It's not just
one magazine, Marge.

They take hundreds of magazines,
filter out the crap...

and leave you with something
that fits right in your front pocket.

God! Those kids don't know
what they're missing.

the House of Representatives
on C-SPAN,

and listen to an inspiring story
of wilderness survival.

the pitiless bark
of the sea lion."

Homer, he obviously got out alive
if he wrote the article.

Don't be so—
Oh, you're right.

Homey, put down your magazine
for a minute.

- Huh?
- I thought you might wanna snuggle.

That reminds me.
"Seven ways to spice up
your marriage."

and if you'd like to
see me in a costume,
you have only to ask."

Where did you get
the idea for this, Mom?

Where do you think?
This baby never steers
you wrong, and it was free!

- Free.
- It certainly has enriched our lives.

Wow. "Win a trip
to Washington, D.C.

- Oh, it's for kids.
- Wait, Dad!

Three-hundred words,
fiercely pro-American."
Sounds interesting.

Bart, maybe this is something
you'd like to do too.

Mom, it's a nice thought,
but we both know that
this is the pony to bet on.

What would Ben Franklin say
if he were alive today?

- How's it going, honey?
- Not very well.

Well, when I used to
get stuck like this,
I'd go for a bike ride.

- Do kids go
on bike rides anymore?
- Yes!

I don't know.
I thought maybe bikes
weren't cool anymore.

- Do kids still use that word "cool"?
- Yes, Mom!

Thanks for driving me
to the contest, Dad.

Sweetheart, there's nothing
I wouldn't do for that magazine.

"So burn the flag if you must,
but before you do...

"you better burn
a few other things.

"You better burn your shirt
and your pants.

" Be sure to burn
your TV and car.

"Oh, yes, and don't forget
to burn your house...

"because none of those things
could exist without six white stripes...

seven red stripes
and a hell of a lot of stars."

" Recipe for a free country:
Mix one cup liberty with
three teaspoons of justice.

Add one informed electorate.
Baste well with veto power."

" My back is spineless.
My belly is yellow.

"Stir in two cups of checks.

" Ding, dong. The sounds
of the Liberty Bell.

Ding— excellent schools.

"When America was born

reading and writing

aspirin, sewing kit,

visit the cockpit.

And this control stick is like

Now, would you
like to see where
we hang our coats?

No, thank you.
I'd rather push
this button. Oops!

Look, Marge, that guy has
the same last name we do. Taxi.!

Here we are, kids.
The Watergate.

Homer, look.!
They give you a shower cap...

And a welcoming mint
on your pillow.

Wow, a shoehorn.
Just like in the movies.

Shoe goes on, shoe goes off,
shoe goes on, shoe goes off.

Shoe goes on,
shoe goes off.

Bart, there's no such thing
as first bedsies.
You just made that up.

Well, okay,
which one do you want?

It's all yours.
Whatever you say.

- Why? What's wrong with it?
- Nothing.

- Have a good night's sleep, Lisa.
- No, really, what?

- Nothing.
- What did you do to it?

What the— D'oh!
Stupid welcoming mint!

- Hello?
- Good morning.
This is your wake-up call.

Lisa, I'm Faith Crowley—
patriotism editor of Reading Digest.

My favorite section is
" How to Increase Your Word Power."

That thing is really,
really, really... good.

Well, good.
Lisa, I'd like you to meet
some other finalists.

- This is Trong Van Dinh
and Maria Dominguez.
- Hello.

Maria is the National
Spelling Bee Champion.

And Trong has won both
the Westinghouse Talent Search...

and the NFL Punt,
Pass and Kick Competition.

Have either of you ever run
into any problems because
of your superior ability?

- Hmm?
- Sure, I guess.
- Oh, me too!

They'll get you into places
other tourists never see.

- Miss, what does the "I" stand for?
- Important.

- Oh! And, miss,
just one more question.
- Person.

- What does the "I" stand for again?
- Oh!

- "On this spot, Richard Nixon
bowled back-to-back 300 games."
- Yeah, right.

Oh, you have
those damn badges.

Okay. This tub
was installed in 1894.

Folks, we print more than
18 million bills a day.

Oh, and in case
you were wondering...

no, we don't give out
free samples.

Bart, get out
of The Spirit of St. Louis.!

Congressman, this is, uh,
Springfield National Forest.

- Now, basically, what we
wanna do is cut her down.
- Uh-huh.

As you can see
in our artist's rendition,
it's full of old growth...

In comes our logging company
to thin out the clutter.

It's all part of nature's,
you know, cycle.

Well, Jerry, you're a whale
of a lobbyist, and, uh...

I'd like to give you a logging permit,
I would, but, uh...

this isn't like
burying toxic waste.

People are gonna notice
those trees are gone.

Eh, Congressman, this is where
it gets awkward.

I— I never quite know
how to put this.

- I just want to—
- Offer me a bribe?

It's that little girl from Springfield
who wrote the essay.

- Could be a good photo-op.
- Sure, fine.

- So, uh, where do we—
- Duh, duh, duh, Not here.

I've got a little place that
I use for these, uh, matters.
Call me tonight.

- Well, hi there.
You must be Lisa Simpson.
- Hello, sir.

Lisa, you're a doer,
and who knows, maybe someday...

you'll be a congressman
or a senator.

We have quite a few
women senators, you know.

You're a sharp one.
Well, how about a few pictures?

Tot shot always plays
in the sticks.

Now there is
a politician who cares.

If I ever vote,
it'll be for him.

Lisa, the contest
isn't for three hours.

Anyone up for the
Winifred Beecher Howe Memorial?

- Who's that?
- An early crusader for women's rights.

She led the Floor Mop
Rebellion of 1 91 0.

Later, she appeared on
the highly unpopular
75-cent piece.

Okay, but you don't know
what you're missing.

"I will iron your sheets
when you iron out...

the inequities
in your labor laws."

I told you
no one ever came here.

So, Bob, where do we stand
on Springfield Forest?
Do I get my logging permit?

Well, let me put it
this way, Jerry. Timber!

How can I read my essay now?
I don't believe my own words.

Honest Abe—
he'll show me the way.

- Mr. Lincoln—
- Mr. Lincoln,
I need your advice.

What can I do to make this
a better country?

Is this a good time
to buy a house?

- I can't get my boy to brush.
- Would I look good
with a mustache?

I tried using turpentine,
but that just made it worse.

My name is Lisa Simpson,
and I have a problem!

Mr. Jefferson,
my name is Lisa Simpson...

- and I have a problem.
- I know your problem.

The Lincoln Memorial
was too crowded.

- Sorry, sir. It's just—
- No one ever comes to see me.

I don't blame them.
I never did anything important—

Maybe I should be going.
I caught you at a bad time.

Wait! Please don't go.
I get so lonely.

Rudy, my man,
you're a miracle worker.

There you go.
Buy yourself something nice.

- Thank you.
- Bart, are you ready to
go to—

- I'll room service you.!
- Before you kill me...

remember, this trip
is all expenses paid.

- Thank you.
- Oh, this guy is awful.

I know, honey,
but just sit still.

Welcome, everyone,
to the awards luncheon.

I'd like to introduce
our distinguished judges...

who will select
our scholarship winner.

Our first essayist
will be Lisa Simpson.

Lisa Simpson
will now read her essay—

I would like to read
a different essay, if I may?

The city of Washington was built
on a stagnant swamp...

some 200 years ago
and very little has changed.

It stank then
and it stinks now.

Only today, it is
the fetid stench of corruption
that hangs in the air.

And who did I see
taking a bribe...

I'm sure you can buy
all the votes you need
with your dirty money.

And this will be one nation
under the dollar...

with liberty
and justice for none.

Senator, there's a problem
at the essay contest.

- Please, son, I'm very busy.
- A little girl...

- is losing faith in democracy.
- Good Lord!

Congressman, we want to drill for
oil in Teddy Roosevelt's head.

- You work fast.
- I work for Uncle Sam.

We will now vote
on the House bill 1022—

Mr. Speaker, I'm all for the bill,
but shouldn't we tack on...

- a pay raise for ourselves?
- No.!

Okay, this should make
my bosses very happy.

- Your bosses?
- Yep. All 250 million of them.

When my family arrived
in this country four months ago...

we spoke no English
and had no money in our pockets.

Today, we own a nationwide chain
of wheel-balancing centers.

Where else but in America—
or possibly Canada—

could our family find
such opportunity?

That's why whenever I see
the stars and stripes...

I'll always be reminded
of that wonderful word "flag."

There will be a brief recess
while the judges tabulate their votes.

Yeah, your other speech
was a little more crowd pleasing.

I'm sorry, Dad.
I couldn't think of a nice way
to say America stinks.

Extra! Extra!
Feds nab rotten rep.

I can't believe it.
The system works.

- He already sang this song.
- No, that was about the budget gap.

And now
the moment of truth.

Will the winning essay be
" Bubble on, O melting pot"?

" USA, A-OK,"
by Trong Van Dinh.

Miss Crowley, thank you
for this oversized novelty check.

I would like share this honor
with all of my fellow essayists...

that the price of freedom
is eternal vigilance.

Lis, you taught me to stand up
for what I believe in.

Driving their new car from Varanasi,
Jojo and company headed towards the country of Pakistan.
We'll be at the Pakistani border soon...
I wasn't sure what we had gotten ourselves into at first...

but I'm already missing the chaos of Calcutta,
and the rushing waters of the Ganges.

I'll be going back there soon.
I need to make Abdul a proper grave.
What's the hold up? Move it!
Hey, did we just fling pebbles at that car?
We don't need to get ourselves into trouble right now.
I'm still wanted for what happened in Varanasi.
Let's just make it across the border alive.
I just finished telling you we don't need any trouble!
I-It's not that, look! There's someone in the way.
I mean, I am a girl after all.
Soon I'll have to wear a bra and do my nails for the boys.
It would be lame if I was still wandering the world by then.
This is the only chance I'll get!
To be able to run away and see the world...
I still feel a bit bad for lying about seeing my dad in Singapore...
but let's just forget about that.
I just let you pass, so get moving!

Do you think maybe he's still angry
about your reckless driving earlier?
No... Maybe it was just the dust, but I couldn't see him.
Now he's signaling me to pass!
I guess he realized his car can't handle it.

You should have just stayed behind me
in the first place, you dumb-ass.
If it weren't for Star Platinum, we'd have all been crushed.
Where is it? Where's that car?
So, you think the driver is one of the Stand users that's after us?
Or was it just some random asshole?
Of course it's someone coming after us!
But we haven't seen anything resembling a Stand's attack yet.
Even so, we need to be careful as we approach the border.

If anyone else comes after us,
we'll have to take them out without question.
Star Platinum put a pretty mean dent in it.
Just pretend like we were never here. Ignore it.
So cool... He makes me go crazy!
If we take our time, we can avoid running into that car again.
Mister, I need to ask you something!
The driver of that car parked out there!{Xemnas: Nuance and all}
I-I wasn't paying attention when that car parked there...
I doubt he will reveal himself.
That leaves us only one option, Jotaro...
Since none of them will come forward... {Changed up this line quite a bit, I think it works better with the next part.}
we'll just have to beat them all!
You too, Mr. Joestar! You're going too far!
You've got a real shifty face, pal!
Guys, did any of you catch his face?
N-No. What do you think he's up to?

He seemed like any other bad driver,
but now it looks like he's following us.
I'll be pissed if we can't track him down and take care of this!

And he's got another thing coming for
that stunt he pulled with the truck earlier!
Shit! For a piece of junk, that thing is pretty quick!

That's odd. According to the map,
we should be running parallel with train tracks right now.
Who the hell cares? We almost have him!
I'll get him for sure on the next curve!
No way! It's a dead end!
Did he really disappear after the curve?
No car could cross such a tiny bridge...
How did he get behind us?
H-He's pushing us with insane horsepower!
Is that thing built like a tank?
It's no use! Guys, get out of the car and run!
What kind of driver gets out of the car before everyone else? {TYPICAL FRENCH}
Who will hold down the brake pedal?
Your Hierophant won't be able to hold all this weight!
Mr. Joestar, I beg your pardon, but I know my own strength.
It flew up with the car's wire winch!
By the way, do you like sumo?
How about a good deadlock? {A deadlock is when two wrestlers are at the edge of the ring and circle each other, refusing to act.}
Ouch... {I'm 90% sure this is Kakyoin here}

But Jotaro, you should know it's
against the rules to punch your opponent.

Since I didn't see anything resembling a Stand attack,
I guess it really was just an angry driver.
Yeah. Either way, there's no way he survived.
I guess he got what he deserved.
That car came behind us out of nowhere.
There ain't... nothin' weird... about it!
It's coming from the car radio!
This was all the work of a Stand, Joestar!

If he knows my name,
that means he's one of the Stand users hunting us!
Could it be from the car that just fell?
It can't be! That thing was totaled!
You're wrong. That car could be a Stand.
Just like the Stand, Strength, was a ship.
That's the card my Stand represents!
No way! It burrowed up through the ground!
I think it's safe to say that car is definitely a Stand!
The Stand's user is controlling it from inside!
It wants to see who's stronger.
Don't, Jotaro! You can't fight it yet!
We don't know what his Stand is capable of!
N-No way... I didn't see a thing...
What did it shoot at me, and how?
once ya got a foot in the grave!
These aren't bad wounds, but they dug deep!

It looked like the Stand was shooting something at us,
but there's nothing sticking out of the wounds!
Don't worry about me. More importantly...
I can't tell what type of attack that is, but it has good accuracy...
I'll break yer legs so you can't escape, then trample you to death!
Are you guys pretending to be cockroaches?
Oh no! It's forcing its way in!
We don't stand a chance against him...

He's like an idiot who can't solve
a simple puzzle ring, and is taking it out on us!

Yeah, It's true I ran away from home,
and I'm good-for-nothing, and I'm all alone, and nobody loves me!
You could've run away in the time it took you to ramble, you brat.
There're no roads left to take!

Not to escape, not to survive, not to Egypt,
and not even toward yer bright future!

my Wheel of Fortune is gonna grind you into mincemeat
and splatter what's left over the rocks!
Is there anything this car can't do?
Looks like we'll have to face it.
When it reaches the top, we'll see the underside of the car.
That's when we'll find out who's stronger.
I see. Once we see the underside, we may be able to attack it!
You guys reek of something, and ya didn't even notice!
Now that he mentions it, I smell gasoline!
So that's what it was... gasoline!
It was shooting small amounts of gasoline at high speed, like bullets!
So he wasn't attacking to wound us, but to drench us in gasoline?
So ya finally got it. But it's too late!
Watch the spark in these electrical wires!
Part Three is over! {Fourth wall breaking ftw!}

Oh? And who exactly is going to replace me,
Kujo Jotaro, as the main character?
You didn't think it'd be you, did you?
You used yer Star Platinum to burrow into the ground!
So all that got burned up was yer jacket!
By the way, weren't you saying something about roads earlier?
A road is a path you make for yourself.
So let me, Kujo Jotaro, show you how it's done.
I'll show you just how roads are built.
Where you went flying, a road has been made.
His arms are enormous, yet the rest of him is so small. {Chronic masturbation at work, folks}
Please don't kill me! I only did it for the money!
I can't believe his Stand was hiding such a tiny car.
It looks like a sheep that's just been shorn. {THAT IS NOT YOUR LINE SIR.}

{\fs(70)}I am a priest in training.
Please do not disturb my meditation by undoing my restraints.

Now then, we'll take this car across the border,
seeing as ours was totaled.

It's in pretty bad shape.
I wonder if it will make it to the border. {Xemnas: More nuance.}
By the way, we're putting you on the next plane to Hong Kong.
Shut it! Can't you see you're just getting in our way?
Well... we might not be making it very far... {Xemnas: Fixed to fit with the change in line 268.}
Sob... {Brolicious: shouldn't these be in italics? Or is she saying "sob"}
All seven Stand users I sent forth have been defeated!
They have tarnished my spotless reputation!
I cannot bear to face Lord Dio!

Curse that despicable Polnareff,
Kakyoin, Jotaro, and that decrepit Joestar!
I, Enya, shall deal with you cretins in person!
I'll use my Stand, represented by the Justice card!
The fog is getting thick up ahead.
He died with pure horror in his eyes!
Looks like this is no ordinary murder.

If it weren't for Star Platinum, we'd have all been crushed.
Where is it? Where's that car?!
So, you think the driver is one of the Stand users that's after us?
Or was it just some random asshole?
Of course it's someone coming after us!
But we haven't seen anything resembling a Stand's attack yet.
Even so, we need to be careful as we approach the border.

If anyone else comes after us,
 we'll have to take them out without question.
Star Platinum put a pretty mean dent in it.
Just pretend like we were never here. Ignore it.
So cool... He makes me go crazy!
If we take our time, we can avoid running into that car again.
Mister, I need to ask you something!
The driver of that car parked out there!
I-I wasn't paying attention when that car parked there...
I doubt he will reveal himself.
That leaves us only one option, Jotaro...
Since none of them will come forward...
...we'll just have to beat them all!
You too, Mr. Joestar! You're going too far!
You've got a real shifty face, pal!
Guys, did any of you catch his face?
N-No. What do you think he's up to?

He seemed like any other bad driver, 
but now it looks like he's following us.
I'll be pissed if we can't track him down and take care of this!

And he's got another thing coming for 
that stunt he pulled with the truck earlier!
Shit! For a piece of junk, that thing is pretty quick!

That's odd. According to the map, 
we should be running parallel with train tracks right now.
Who the hell cares? We almost have him!
I'll get him for sure on the next curve!
No way! It's a dead end!
Did he really disappear after the curve?
No car could cross such a tiny bridge...
How did he get behind us?!
H-He's pushing us with insane horsepower!
Is that thing built like a tank?!
It's no use! Guys, get out of the car and run!
What kind of driver gets out of the car before everyone else?
Who will hold down the brake pedal?!
Your Hierophant won't be able to hold all this weight!
Mr. Joestar, I beg your pardon, but I know my own strength.
It flew up with the car's wire winch!
By the way, do you like sumo?

But Jotaro, you should know it's 
against the rules to punch your opponent.

Since I didn't see anything resembling a Stand attack, 
I guess it really was just an angry driver.
Yeah. Either way, there's no way he survived.
I guess he got what he deserved.
That car came behind us out of nowhere.
There ain't... nothin' weird... about it!
It's coming from the car radio!
This was all the work of a Stand, Joestar!

If he knows my name, 
that means he's one of the Stand users hunting us!
Could it be from the car that just fell?
It can't be! That thing was totaled!
You're wrong. That car could be a Stand.
Just like the Stand, Strength, was a ship.
That's the card my Stand represents!
No way! It burrowed up through the ground!
I think it's safe to say that car is definitely a Stand!
The Stand's user is controlling it from inside!
It wants to see who's stronger.
Don't, Jotaro! You can't fight it yet!
We don't know what his Stand is capable of!
N-No way... I didn't see a thing...
What did it shoot at me, and how?
...once ya got a foot in the grave!
These aren't bad wounds, but they dug deep!

It looked like the Stand was shooting something at us, 
but there's nothing sticking out of the wounds!
Don't worry about me. More importantly...
...I can't tell what type of attack that is, but it has good accuracy...
I'll break yer legs so you can't escape, then trample you to death!
Are you guys pretending to be cockroaches?!
Oh no! It's forcing its way in!
We don't stand a chance against him...

He's like an idiot who can't solve 
a simple puzzle ring, and is taking it out on us!

Yeah, It's true I ran away from home, 
and I'm good-for-nothing, and I'm all alone, and nobody loves me!
You could've run away in the time it took you to ramble, you brat.
There're no roads left to take!

Not to escape, not to survive, not to Egypt, 
and not even toward yer bright future!

...my Wheel of Fortune is gonna grind you into mincemeat 
and splatter what's left over the rocks!
Is there anything this car can't do?!
Looks like we'll have to face it.
When it reaches the top, we'll see the underside of the car.
That's when we'll find out who's stronger.
I see. Once we see the underside, we may be able to attack it!
You guys reek of something, and ya didn't even notice!
Now that he mentions it, I smell gasoline!
So that's what it was... gasoline!
It was shooting small amounts of gasoline at high speed, like bullets!
So he wasn't attacking to wound us, but to drench us in gasoline?!
So ya finally got it. But it's too late!
Watch the spark in these electrical wires!

Oh? And who exactly is going to replace me, 
Kujo Jotaro, as the main character?
You didn't think it'd be you, did you?
You used yer Star Platinum to burrow into the ground!
So all that got burned up was yer jacket!
By the way, weren't you saying something about roads earlier?
A road is a path you make for yourself.
So let me, Kujo Jotaro, show you how it's done.
I'll show you just how roads are built.
Where you went flying, a road has been made.
His arms are enormous, yet the rest of him is so small.
Please don't kill me! I only did it for the money!
I can't believe his Stand was hiding such a tiny car.
It looks like a sheep that's just been shorn.

I am a priest in training. 
Please do not disturb my meditation by undoing my restraints.

Now then, we'll take this car across the border, 
seeing as ours was totaled.

It's in pretty bad shape.
 I wonder if it will make it to the border.
By the way, we're putting you on the next plane to Hong Kong.
Shut it! Can't you see you're just getting in our way?
Well... we might not be making it very far...
All seven Stand users I sent forth have been defeated!
They have tarnished my spotless reputation!
I cannot bear to face Lord Dio!

Curse that despicable Polnareff, 
Kakyoin, Jotaro, and that decrepit Joestar!
I, Enya, shall deal with you cretins in person!
I'll use my Stand, represented by the Justice card!
The fog is getting thick up ahead.
He died with pure horror in his eyes!
Looks like this is no ordinary murder.
